top_signals.title: The Middle East War Has Wiped 2.8 Billion Barrels Off Global Oil Supply
top_signals.summary: The war in the Middle East has caused global oil supply losses of a total of 2.8 billion barrels plus 60 billion cubic meters of natural gas, the International Energy Agency estimated in its latest World Energy Outlook, released today. This disruption is going to affect oil demand, the IEA predicted, but only if governments around the world stay the course with accelerated electrification to reduce consumption of hydrocarbons.
